source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Peer review is the manager’s annual employment-performance appraisal of a nurse’s attendance, goals, and job performance.","B":"Peer review is informal feedback between coworkers that is not intended to assess practice against professional standards.","C":"Nursing peer review is a systematic assessment by nursing peers of the quality and appropriateness of nursing care against professional standards.","D":"Peer review is the credentialing process used to verify an applicant’s initial education and licensure before employment."}}
source_row.rationale: ANA describes nursing peer review as a systematic assessment by practicing registered nurses of the quality of nursing care provided by peers against professional standards. It is intended to support accountability, learning, and practice improvement rather than function as a purely punitive process.
